{{Quote|We won't say a word. We won't say we saw you. Just go. Get out. We don't want your help.|The villager to RC-1336|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''villager''' resided on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'' in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the villager was approached by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1336]], who enquired about the whereabouts of [[Ghez Hokan]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] employed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After initially thinking the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] was Hokan himself due to his [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|armor]], she stated that Hokan had taken over the [[Kirmay clan's farm]] and used it as a staging area for fifty to sixty of his mercenaries. Once she had passed this information to the commando, she demanded he leave, which he did.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The villager appeared in the [[2004]] novel [[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|''Hard Contact'']], which was written by [[Karen Traviss]] as the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series.<ref name="RC:HC" />
